newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: DB to cancel 3 out of every 4 shares.
newsitem.headline: DB to cancel 3 out of every 4 shares.

text.p: Brewer DB Group Ltd said on Wednesday that current cash balances were surplus to requirements and it was returning them to shareholders.

It said the 1997 annual meeting would be asked to approval the cancellation of three out of every four fully-paid shares on issue, with a tax-free cash payment of 60 NZ cents for each cancelled share.
DB said the proposal was subject to approval of the High Court and would involve the return of about NZ$181 million to shareholders.
The Inland Revenue had issued a binding ruling acknowledging the distribution would not be a dividend for tax purposes and would be tax-free to shareholders.
DB said its directors anticipated implementing an increased dividend ratio.
DB is 59.8 percent owned by Asia Pacific Breweries Ltd, a venture between Heineken NV and Fraser and Neave Ltd.
DB shares were up eight cents to NZ$1.03 shortly after the news. -- Wellington Newsroom 64 4 4734 746
